_comment: The strict major-union membership rule, unit level: a generation belongs to version V iff it IS V or begins with V followed by a DOT. String test, mandatory dot, no numeric normalization. must-fail cases are non-members. See TESTING.md.

provenance.ref: the IS-V arm of the rule: a bare-integer line is a member of its own version

mutation.description: generation equals the version exactly, the simplest member

provenance.ref: claude-4.0 is the fold target of claude@4 and must be in the claude-4 union

mutation.description: generation gains a .0 minor, the spelling the N->N.0 fold produces

provenance.ref: user ruling: claude-4 returns all of the 4.x series, 4.8 among them
grok@4.20 is a real catalog generation; a two-digit minor must not confuse the rule

mutation.description: the minor part is two digits, so a naive single-char assumption would break

provenance.ref: the major is not restricted to a single digit

mutation.description: the major part is two digits

provenance.ref: ruled: sub-1.0 lines union under version 0 verbatim, needing no exemption

mutation.description: the version is 0, the value that would need a special case under a numeric rule

provenance.ref: the narrow rung is the same rule as the union rung: a fully specified version is a union of one

mutation.description: the version carries a minor, so the rule must still admit the exact match

provenance.ref: no such generation exists today, but the rule must be well-defined if a patch level ever appears

mutation.description: a third version component is added, which the begins-with-V-dot arm must admit

provenance.ref: the mandatory dot: a plain string-prefix rule would wrongly swallow 42 into version 4

mutation.description: the dot is removed from a would-be member, which must make it a non-member

provenance.ref: the separator must be a dot specifically, not merely any non-digit

mutation.description: the dot is replaced by a letter

provenance.ref: the taxonomy stays p-unaware: p-notation is decoded at PARSE into a real dotted version, never admitted by a p-aware selector rule

mutation.description: the dot is replaced by a p, the upstream spelling the parse layer decodes

provenance.ref: ling@1t and ring@1t are mis-parsed 1-trillion parameter sizes, not versions; they must not be reachable by --version 1

mutation.description: a unit letter follows the digit instead of a dotted minor

provenance.ref: minimax@01 is a real generation spelling; no numeric normalization means it is not version 1

mutation.description: a leading zero is added, which a numeric rule would erase and a string rule must not

provenance.ref: gemini@001 and text-embedding@002/@005 are real generation spellings excluded by the strict rule
minimax@25 and qwen@25 are dot-lost upstream spellings; the selector must not guess where the dot went

mutation.description: the dot is deleted from 2.5, which must make it a non-member rather than a silent member

provenance.ref: the ordinary negative: a generation of another major is not in this union
the narrow rung must NOT be equivalent to the union — this is the user's core refinement

mutation.description: the version is fully specified to a different minor of the same major

provenance.ref: an un-versioned (bare) line has no generation to select and must never join a version union

mutation.description: the generation is emptied, the shape carried by the 204 bare lines

provenance.ref: an empty version must not degenerate into a prefix that matches everything

mutation.description: the version is emptied, the degenerate input a careless prefix test would treat as universal
